question: Where’s the closest golf course positioned in the direction of west from Wildlife West Nature Park, Edgewood, NM?
sql: WITH park_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Wildlife West Nature Park%' LIMIT 1 ), golf_courses_west AS ( SELECT poi_name AS name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, park_location.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters FROM pois p, park_location WHERE p.leisure = 'golf_course' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(park_location.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5 UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, ST_Distance(pa.geometry::geography, park_location.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters FROM parks pa, park_location WHERE pa.leisure = 'golf_course' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(park_location.geometry, pa.geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5 ) SELECT name, distance_meters FROM golf_courses_west ORDER BY distance_meters ASC LIMIT 1;

metadata.final_exec_err: ST_Azimuth(geography, geography) is only valid for point inputs
